verdict.rationale: Formant's own docs describe real-time, low-latency peer-to-peer teleoperation over WebRTC with joystick, buttons, or custom controls, which covers the responsive-control core of the story. However, no cited item explicitly documents live video streaming within the teleop session, so coverage is partial. The low-bandwidth mode only addresses the agent's passive duties, so it does not show teleop resilience on constrained networks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of live video feeds during teleoperation, evidence of performance or degradation handling over constrained real-world networks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of latency claims.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can teleoperate a remote robot with live video and responsive control over real-world networks
